Nucleus.title: Nucleus
Nucleus.description: Represents a core entity within BindNexus, identifiable by an ID and name, and can be associated with bind codes and operations. It can have an AI-generated description and tags.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Nucleus entity.

name.description: The human-readable name of the Nucleus.

description.description: An optional, concise description of the Nucleus, potentially AI-generated based on its name or purpose.

tags.description: An optional list of relevant tags for the Nucleus, potentially AI-generated.

ownerId.description: The UID of the user who owns this Nucleus.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the Nucleus was created.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the Nucleus was last updated.

BindCode.title: BindCode
BindCode.description: Represents a unique alphanumeric bind code generated by the system, including its status, associated metadata, and linkage to a Nucleus.

id.description: Unique identifier for the BindCode entity.

code.description: The actual unique alphanumeric bind code (e.g., 'XXXX' in ':bind XXXX').

description.description: An optional description or purpose for the bind code.

status.description: The current status of the bind code (e.g., 'active', 'used', 'expired').

totalCredits.description: The initial total credits allocated to this specific bind.

remainingCredits.description: The current remaining credits for this bind.

ownerId.description: Reference to the User who owns this bind code.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the BindCode was created.

/users/{userId}/bindCodes/{bindCodeId}.description: User's collection of generated bind codes.

/users/{userId}/creditHistory/{logId}.description: Audit log of credit consumption for a user.

/users/{userId}/bindHistory/{logId}.description: History of bind operations for a user.
